answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by issuing each identity a jade-bound credential that cannot be copied. A newcomer must present a relic of prior honest work signed by real devices, so spawning clones from nothing is impossible. Peers prune any walnut-weight duplicate that lacks a matching history, slashing its stake. Because every forged twin must repay the full setup cost, an attacker gains no economy of scale from mass identity creation.
